title: helperConsumers
responsibility: Counts runtime owners and proves concrete instantiated service classes, public instance methods and per-class consumers at the selected revision.

inputs.name: helperConsumers.tree
inputs.description: The source tree for the selected revision: read(path) loads the units config and each active owned source file, and the optional list() supplies the import-resolution paths (owned script and Svelte paths are used when it is absent). Read failures are swallowed, so an unreadable or invalid config falls back to defaultUnitsConfig and an unreadable file contributes no references or forwards, but a rejecting list() rejects helperConsumers, and the function never checks which revision the tree describes.

inputs.name: helperConsumers.units
inputs.description: Registered units to scan: only units with status 'active' contribute owned source, helpers and service exports, so inactive units never count as consumers, and a unit's own references to its service exports are skipped. Each consumer is distinct per unit and caller symbol, but units in the component or service categories and references to service exports count as the unit alone, while other references without a named caller are ignored.

examples.title: helperConsumers
examples.responsibility: Counts runtime owners and proves concrete instantiated service classes, public instance methods and per-class consumers at the selected revision.

inputs.name: serviceClasses.units
inputs.description: Units to annotate in place: each unit's serviceClasses is replaced, becoming empty when it has no serviceExports, with each service export that resolves (directly or through forwards) to a non-abstract class declared in that unit's own owned source, and each class lists its inherited methods, consumer units and constructedBy units. Exports of the same class are merged, and helperConsumers passes only active units.

examples.title: helperConsumers
examples.responsibility: Counts runtime owners and proves concrete instantiated service classes, public instance methods and per-class consumers at the selected revision.

inputs.name: serviceClasses.facts
inputs.description: Helper facts keyed by repository source path, supplying each file's class declarations, forwards and references. helperConsumers fills it only for owned JavaScript, TypeScript and Svelte files of active units, and a path with no entry counts as having no classes, forwards or references.

inputs.name: serviceClasses.lookup
inputs.description: Lookup for exported classes: users maps each source#name key to its consumers keyed by unit and symbol, target(path, binding) resolves an import binding to a source path for base classes and forwards (or undefined), and reference(path, reference) resolves a construction or runtime reference to its source#name key (or undefined).

outputs.name: helperConsumers
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after updating units in place: every helper gets its distinct, sorted consumers, every unit gets serviceConsumers (the distinct units that consume its service exports), and each active unit gets serviceClasses with methods, consumers and constructedBy. Consumers and class facts come only from active units' owned source.

errors.name: tree.list rejection
errors.description: Any error that tree.list() rejects with propagates unchanged out of helperConsumers, because that await is not inside a try block.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when tree.list() resolves to a value that cannot be mapped, such as null or undefined, or to a list containing null entries, because the result is mapped without a guard.
